clauses.quote: After the surplus process is complete, the Superintendent may release as many teachers as necessary.

A meeting between the Superintendent, or designee, and a representative of the Association will be set at least 10 days prior to any final action by the District to reduce teachers as the result of a district-wide reduction in force.
clauses.subject_text: A meeting between the Superintendent, or designee, and a representative of the Association

clauses.quote: All unplaced teachers will be reviewed by the number of their respective endorsements and certifications according to the staffing needs of the District.
Any teacher who has received a current (within the existing school year) written notice of suspension will not be eligible to displace another teacher.
clauses.subject_text: Any teacher who has received a current (within the existing school year) written notice of suspension

clauses.quote: If a choice must be made between two or more teachers determined by the District to be equally well qualified for the position, the teacher with the most advanced degree and lane placement according to the teacher salary schedule will be retained.
clauses.subject_text: the teacher with the most advanced degree and lane placement according to the teacher salary schedule

clauses.quote: Teachers released through this process, who are not on active corrective discipline as found within their district personnel file, shall be given the first right of interview for positions for which they are qualified that become available during the six months following their release.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers released through this process, who are not on active corrective discipline as found within their district personnel file

clauses.quote: Notification of the available position shall be made by a certified letter to the last known address of the former employee.
The offer of interview shall advise the person that they have seven days after the postmarked date of the letter to accept or reject the offer of interview.
If rehired under this section, teachers will be placed on the step they would have received if they had not been released.
Offers not accepted or responded to by the seventh day are deemed rejected.
clauses.subject_text: Offers not accepted or responded to by the seventh day
clauses.notes: Procedural status rule regarding offer expiration.

clauses.quote: The Board and a teacher may mutually agree to terminate the teacher's contract at any time.
A teacher may retire from employment at the end of the first semester in January by submitting written notice to Human Resources no
